note: Generated by Studio's gen-rpe-text-effects script from Studio's presets. A content file names one with preset: <key>.

presets.name: Seasick
presets.blurb: Each letter bobs on a sine wave a little behind the one before it.

presets.name: Leapfrog
presets.blurb: Letters jump one after another and land back on their own shadows.

presets.name: Tremor
presets.blurb: Every letter jitters by a whole pixel, sixteen times a second.

presets.name: Jelly
presets.blurb: Squash and stretch, anchored at the baseline so letters never lift off.

presets.name: Cartwheel
presets.blurb: Each letter makes one full turn about its own centre, rolling through the word, then rests.

presets.name: Coin Flip
presets.blurb: Letters flip like coins. The back face is mirrored and darker, and the edge catches light.

presets.name: Heartbeat
presets.blurb: A lub-dub pulse: two beats close together, then a rest. The colour flushes with each.

presets.name: Typewriter
presets.blurb: Letters are typed in left to right with a pop and a blinking caret, then the line starts over.

presets.name: Haunted
presets.blurb: Pale letters drift in loops, trailed by three fading echoes of where they were.

presets.name: Banner
presets.blurb: Every column of pixels rides a travelling ripple, lit where the cloth faces up.

presets.name: Spectrum
presets.blurb: The classic: hue runs along the line, one pixel column at a time, and scrolls.

presets.name: Sunset
presets.blurb: A three-stop gradient, orange to pink to violet, drifting slowly through the word.

presets.name: Enchanted
presets.blurb: An epic-rarity purple with two layers of glint sliding across it, like an enchanted item.

presets.name: Hologram
presets.blurb: Iridescent and see-through, with rolling scanlines, colour fringes and the odd skip.

presets.name: Confetti
presets.blurb: Every letter its own cycling colour and its own hop, under a slow fall of confetti.

presets.name: Legendary
presets.blurb: Banded gold with a dark rim, a shine that sweeps through every few seconds, and four-point sparkles.

presets.name: Blaze
presets.blurb: Pixel flames lick up off every letter, posterised to five heats, over a glowing body.

presets.name: Magma
presets.blurb: Molten rock flowing down through the letters, with a cooling crust and white-hot cracks.

presets.name: Frostbite
presets.blurb: Ice-blue faceted letters with snow on every upper edge, icicles under them, and the odd glint.

presets.name: Fish Tank
presets.blurb: The letters are tanks of water: dark above the line, blue below, with a surface that rolls along the word.

presets.name: Molten Tank
presets.blurb: The same tank, filled with lava: a glowing crust, bubbles that pop at the surface, and heat haze over it.

presets.name: Slime
presets.blurb: Glossy green letters that grow drips, which stretch, let go and fall.

presets.name: Radioactive
presets.blurb: Radioactive green with bubbles rising through it and popping off the top, and a sickly glow.

presets.name: Starlight
presets.blurb: A slow nebula seen through the letters, with stars that twinkle and a violet halo.

presets.name: Data Rain
presets.blurb: Falling green streaks seen through the letters, each column at its own speed.

presets.name: Tube Light
presets.blurb: A glass tube with a soft glow around it. It buzzes, and one letter is on the blink.

presets.name: Overcharged
presets.blurb: White-hot letters with crackling arcs jumping round them and the occasional surge.

presets.name: Chunky
presets.blurb: Extruded like a block of diamond, and the light swings so you see the depth shift.

presets.name: Sticker
presets.blurb: A vinyl sticker: thick white border, a hard drop shadow and a gloss that sweeps across.

presets.name: Corrupted
presets.blurb: In bursts: slices tear sideways, the channels split into red and cyan, and dead pixels flash.

presets.name: Embers
presets.blurb: Pixels burn away at a glowing edge and float up as embers, then the word pulls itself back together.

presets.name: Decrypting
presets.blurb: Letters start as flickering static and lock into place one by one, then scramble again.
